_comment: Damian — research-only stock scanner. Scores the find_pairs.UNIVERSE on valuation (forward P/E), earnings quality, and macro/trend. NEVER places orders.
_universe_note: 'scans' = market-wide discovery via saved Robinhood screeners (data/damian_scan_results.json). 'find_pairs' falls back to the fixed 156-name pair universe, which is NOT for discovery. Scan ids live in data/damian_scans.json; the routine runs them with run_scan.

confluence._comment: A name surfacing in more than one independent screen is the single strongest signal Damian has - value AND quality AND trend agreeing. Adds to the composite score.

valuation._comment: Forward P/E is CONSTRUCTED: blended fwd EPS = last 3 reported quarters + next quarter's estimate. Robinhood exposes no forward-PE field.

prescreen._comment: Stage 1: rank the whole universe on data that is CHEAP to fetch (fundamentals are 10 symbols/call, prices are already pulled). Only the survivors get stage-2 earnings calls, which cost 1 MCP call per symbol.
